name: Knorr soup
ingredients_raw: Refined Wheat flour (Maida), Sugar, Milk Solids, Hydrolyzed Vegetable Protein, lodised salt, Flavours - Natural (Garlic) and Nature Identical Flavouring Substances, Dehydrated Vegetables (Onion (1.8%), Leeks (0.4%)), Dehydrated Chicken (2.2%) (Stabilizer - 461 & 407, Antioxidant - 300), Hydrogenated Palm Oil, Thickener - 415, Flavour Enhancer - 627 & 631, Spices & Condiments (Black Pepper (0.3%)), Food Colour - Caramel IV. Contains Wheat and Milk. May Contain Traces of Soya, Mustard, Celery and Nuts.
